theorem FArithmeticPhysical.both_tests_original_physical_net.{u_1} : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K]
  [inst_1 : NumberField K] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
  [inst_3 : MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] [inst_4 : MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)]
  (addHaar : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)) (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K))
  [inst_5 : mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [inst_6 : SFinite mu] [inst_7 : IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu] (a l r s : ℝ)
  (hlr : l ≤ r) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (hh : Continuous phi)
  (hc : HasCompactSupport phi),
  (∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x = 0 → phi x = 0) →
    ∀ (q : Fin 2) (omega : ℝ → ℝ → MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ),
      (∀ (L e : ℝ), FPhysicalFilter.ValidCutoff L e → AEStronglyMeasurable (omega L e) mu) →
        (∀ (L e : ℝ), FPhysicalFilter.ValidCutoff L e → ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), ‖omega L e x‖ ≤ 1) →
          (∀ (L e : ℝ),
              FPhysicalFilter.ValidCutoff L e →
                ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
                  L⁻¹ + e ≤ Real.exp (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x) →
                    Real.exp (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x) ≤ L - e → omega L e x = 1) →
            have tests := ⋯;
            have b := fun x => PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x);
            have A :=
              PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q) ⋯ ⋯;
            let E :=
              DSourceKernel.sourceSpan mu 0 0
                (OAllCharacterClosure.fullSourceMap K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s);
            ∀ (T : Finset ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
              Tendsto
                  (fun p =>
                    ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
                      omega p.1 (p.2 / p.1) x * DSourceKernel.finiteKernel mu b (E T) A x x ∂mu)
                  FPhysicalFilter.cutoffRegime (𝓝 (Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((E T).starProjection.comp A))) ∧
                Tendsto
                  (fun p =>
                    ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
                      omega p.1 (p.2 / p.1) x *
                        DSourceKernel.residualKernel mu b (E T) A
                          (fun x y => LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q (x * y⁻¹)) x x ∂mu)
                  FPhysicalFilter.cutoffRegime (𝓝 (-Masullo.TraceClass.trace ((E T).starProjection.comp A))) :=
fun K [Field K] [NumberField K] [MeasurableSpace (MasulloGRH.HeckeAdeles K)]
    [MeasurableMul₂ (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] [MeasurableInv (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)] addHaar mu
    [mu.IsMulLeftInvariant] [SFinite mu] [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure mu] a l r s hlr hs phi hh hc hphi q omega hm hb hp =>
  id fun T =>
    ⟨FPhysicalFilter.interval_source_kernel_cutoff_net K mu l r s
        (DSourceKernel.sourceSpan mu 0 0
          (OAllCharacterClosure.fullSourceMap K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s) T)
        (PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q)
          (LIntegrated.requiredTest_compact K phi hh hc q).left (LIntegrated.requiredTest_compact K phi hh hc q).right)
        omega hm hb hp,
      FPhysicalFilter.interval_residual_kernel_cutoff_net K mu l r s
        (DSourceKernel.sourceSpan mu 0 0
          (OAllCharacterClosure.fullSourceMap K addHaar mu (a + (l + r) / 2) ((r - l) / 2) s) T)
        (PIntervalConvolution.intervalConvolutionCLM K mu l r s hlr hs (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q)
          (LIntegrated.requiredTest_compact K phi hh hc q).left (LIntegrated.requiredTest_compact K phi hh hc q).right)
        (fun x y => LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q (x * y⁻¹))
        (fun x =>
          id
            (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a => LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q _a = 0) (mul_inv_cancel x)))
              (LIntegrated.requiredTest_at_one K phi hphi q)))
        omega hm hb hp⟩

theorem FGlobalPhysical.source_complement_basis_physical_net.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K]
  [inst_1 : NumberField K] {κ : Type u_2} [Countable κ] (mu : Measure (MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K)) (l r s : ℝ)
  (S : Submodule ℂ ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)) [inst_3 : S.HasOrthogonalProjection] (e : HilbertBasis κ ℂ ↥Sᗮ)
  (A : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu) →L[ℂ] ↥(Lp ℂ 2 mu)),
  (Summable fun i => ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A) ↑(e i)‖) →
    ∀ (omega : ℝ → ℝ → MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ),
      (∀ (L e : ℝ), FPhysicalFilter.ValidCutoff L e → AEStronglyMeasurable (omega L e) mu) →
        (∀ (L e : ℝ), FPhysicalFilter.ValidCutoff L e → ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), ‖omega L e x‖ ≤ 1) →
          (∀ (L e : ℝ),
              FPhysicalFilter.ValidCutoff L e →
                ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K),
                  L⁻¹ + e ≤ Real.exp (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x) →
                    Real.exp (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x) ≤ L - e → omega L e x = 1) →
            have d := fun x =>
              ∑' (i : κ),
                HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel
                  (fun y => PIntervalConvolution.intervalHalfWeight l r s (Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K y)) 1
                  (↑↑↑(e i)) (↑↑((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A) ↑(e i))) x x;
            have PA := (1 - S.starProjection).comp A;
            Integrable d mu ∧
              ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), d x ∂mu = Masullo.TraceClass.trace PA ∧
                Tendsto (fun p => ∫ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), omega p.1 (p.2 / p.1) x * d x ∂mu)
                  FPhysicalFilter.cutoffRegime (𝓝 (Masullo.TraceClass.trace PA)) :=
fun K [Field K] [NumberField K] {κ} [Countable κ] mu l r s S [S.HasOrthogonalProjection] e A hs omega hm hb hp =>
  have hc :=
    have he := fun i => id (Orthonormal.norm_eq_one (HilbertBasis.orthonormal e) i);
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun x => Summable x)
          (funext fun i =>
            Eq.trans (congrArg (HMul.hMul ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A) ↑(e i)‖) ((fun i => he i) i))
              (mul_one ‖(ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A) ↑(e i)‖))))
      hs;
  FGlobalPhysical.nuclear_kernel_physical_net K mu l r s ((1 - S.starProjection).comp A)
    (fun n => (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A) ↑(e n)) (fun n => ↑(e n)) hc
    (HOperatorTrace.source_complement_basis_factor S e A) omega hm hb hp
